google-deepmind_deepmind-research/option.run_keyboard_evaluation: run the eval_keyboard_fig5 script to evaluate trained keyboard models across multiple weight configurations
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/option.evaluate_keyboard_function: evaluate a keyboard model by running episodes with different weight vectors and collecting returns
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/option.generate_polar_plot_data: generate raw data for polar plots visualizing how well a keyboard covers the weight space
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/option.run_episode_with_agent: run an episode using the regressed agent with a keyboard-wrapped scavenger environment
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/option.export_returns_to_csv: export evaluation returns to a CSV file with angle, return value, and keyboard index columns

google-deepmind_deepmind-research/option.step_agent: call step on the Agent to select random actions during training or return regressed weights during evaluation
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/option.update_agent: call update on the Agent with environment transitions to accumulate replay and trigger gradient descent when batch is full
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/option.get_logs_agent: call get_logs on the Agent to retrieve the current regressed cumulant weight values as a dictionary
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/option.review_agent_class: review the Agent class that regresses cumulant weights via TensorFlow gradient descent to predict rewards

google-deepmind_deepmind-research/option.run_train_phi_model: run the phi model training script with absl flags for num_phis, learning_rate, and export_path
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/option.collect_experience_scavenger_env: create a function that collects random action experience from a scavenger environment and returns observations, actions, and rewards
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/option.build_phimodel_network: build a Sonnet MLP-based PhiModel that maps arena observations and actions to phi values with configurable dimensionality
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/option.train_phis_to_rewards: train a linear mapping from learned phis to auxiliary task rewards using Adam optimizer with weight normalization
